data.name: Aiursoft assessed ChopInsight’s physical equipment, computing resources, application requirements and future AI plans together. data.name: Aiursoft brought ChopInsight’s existing infrastructure, emerging AI requirements and business applications into one stable, scalable platform—protecting earlier investments while preparing the business for continued AI adoption.

data.name: Previously, one server would often be associated with one application. Under the new model, servers became computing resources within a shared platform while applications were managed independently of individual machines.
